item.title: Rubio Expected to Press Allies Over Strait of Hormuz at G7 Meeting
item.summary: The meeting in France is slated to discuss efforts to stop the war in the Middle East, end Iran’s nuclear and ballistic missile development, and reopen maritime trade routes.

item.title: Resurgent Inflation Tests Faith in Fed’s Willingness to Tame It
item.summary: The war in the Middle East risks worsening an inflation problem that the Federal Reserve has struggled for years to subdue.

item.title: UAE and Qatar Arrest Hundreds Over Online Videos of Iranian Attacks
item.summary: The authorities have made a wave of arrests to stop people posting footage of strikes, citing security risks. Experts also see a fear of damage to the countries’ image as safe havens.

item.title: Here’s What Happened in the War in the Middle East on Thursday
item.summary: For a second time, President Trump extended the deadline for Iran to fully reopen the Strait of Hormuz.

item.title: As Markets Revolt in the Face of War, Trump Extends Iran Deadline
item.summary: Just after stocks ended another bruising day, the president took to social media to promote progress in talks with Iran.

item.title: G.O.P. Senator Weighs Forcing Congress to Vote to Authorize the Iran War
item.summary: Senator Lisa Murkowski of Alaska is drafting a formal authorization for the use of military force in Iran, seeking to put some parameters around the operation as the Trump administration has boxed out Congress.

item.title: Displaced by War, Many Seek Shelter in Beirut
item.summary: Over 100,000 people have fled to temporary shelters as Israel continues strikes on Lebanon.

item.title: Standoff With Iran Raises Fresh Doubts About Trump’s Freestyle Diplomacy
item.summary: A jumble of emissaries — a friend, a family member, a dove and a hawk — on the Iran crisis reflects President Trump’s improvisational approach.

item.title: Trump Extends Iran Deadline on Strait of Hormuz as Stocks Tumble
item.summary: President Trump pivoted after escalating threats. Israel also announced it had killed an Iranian commander leading efforts to block the Strait of Hormuz to almost all shipping traffic.

item.title: Mortgage Rates Jump Again as Iran War Effects Ripple Through Housing Market
item.summary: The average rate on a 30-year mortgage in the United States hit 6.38 percent, the fourth increase since the war began.
